acceptance: Hudi write/read rows equal on PySpark 3.5, 4.0 and 4.1 with the pinned Hudi release, recorded in docs/internal/hudi-spark-support.md.
Spark 4.2 still refuses with a message naming the missing bundle; a unit test covers 4.1 accepted and 4.2 refused.
The changelog fragment states the new supported range.
description:
#4024 pinned HUDI_VERSION = "1.1.0" in benchbox/platforms/dataframe/hudi_maintenance.py and refuses every Spark line except 3.5 and 4.0. Its matrix in docs/internal/hudi-spark-support.md tested Spark 4.1.1 only with the 4.0 bundle (hudi-spark4.0-bundle_2.13:1.1.0), which fails with ClassNotFoundException. That was the wrong bundle for 4.1.

Facts checked 2026-11-08:
- The Hudi 1.2 release notes say 'Support for Spark 4.1 bundles are added in Hudi 1.2.0' (https://hudi.apache.org/releases/release-1.2).
- The Hudi 1.2.1 quick-start support matrix lists Spark 4.1.x, 4.0.x, 3.5.x, 3.4.x and 3.3.x, with Scala 2.13 and Java 17+ for Spark 4.x (https://hudi.apache.org/docs/quick-start-guide/).
- Maven Central publishes hudi-spark4.1-bundle_2.13 at 1.2.0 and 1.2.1, and hudi-spark4.0-bundle_2.13 at 1.1.0 to 1.2.1. No hudi-spark4.2 bundle is published, so no released Hudi supports Spark 4.2.

Not yet verified locally: a heavy-run attempt on 2026-11-08 was refused by memory admission. The check script is at /tmp/hudi41/check.py (ephemeral): a 10-row insert, then a read with collect() equality.

Change. Move HUDI_VERSION to 1.2.1, or the newest release that keeps 3.5 and 4.0 working. Add (4, 1) -> hudi-spark4.1-bundle_2.13. Re-run the 10-row write/read on PySpark 3.5, 4.0 and 4.1 with JDK 17. Keep Spark 4.2 refused, with a message saying no Hudi release ships a 4.2 bundle yet. Update docs/internal/hudi-spark-support.md and the RuntimeError text.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree; heavy runs through make heavy-run (do not bypass admission); no explanatory comments; changelog fragment.
